android.desc:
SWAP - No ROOT creates a SWAP file on your device's storage, without needing root. You choose the size and the location, and you decide when to delete it.

How it works:
1. Choose the size of the SWAP file, within the app's limits.
2. Choose where the file is created, if your device has more than one storage option.
3. Follow the creation progress until it finishes.
4. Delete the file anytime to free up the space.

Before you create a file:
• The file takes up space on the storage you pick. Check your free space first.
